To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The conceptual model is a valuable asset that can be used to mediate between heterogeneous data and computation sources and multiple users with different requirements for the same information.

(1) a conceptual model is an excellent basis for the design of a mediator, (2) a conceptual model can be used to control the selection of data and procedural resources from multiple autonomous systems, (3) a conceptual model that includes both data and procedural elements can be used to provide a single consistent interface for heterogeneous clients, and (4) the conceptual model can be extended to include the client interface.
The use of a mediator based on a conceptual model is a viable approach to providing access to heterogeneous, autonomous information resources.

the design of conceptual models and their use in mediating between users and information systems.
the use of a conceptual data model as the basis for a mediator for fixed-income securities analysis.
